description: Native spark.py/lakesail.py apply AQE/CBO via connection.conf.set(); snowpark_connect.py via self._session.sql() - both bypass the RecordingConnection's wrapped execute()/cursor().execute(), so the applied ledger stays empty and overall_status derives 'noop' for tuned native-Spark/Snowpark runs (under-reports; never a false 'applied'). Extend capture to conf.set + session.sql. From tuning-applied-ledger-and-validation-status-20260712 review.

deferrals.reason: Native Spark (SparkLikeAdapterMixin.apply_platform_optimizations spark.conf.set, covering spark.py + lakesail.py) is implemented in this PR. The Snowpark portion is deferred: the current snowpark_connect.py applies NO tuning-derived self._session.sql(...) statement — apply_platform_optimizations (SparkTuningMixin) returns [] and configure_for_benchmark issues only ALTER SESSION SET USE_CACHED_RESULT (benchmarking hygiene applied to ALL runs, not tuning). Recording that would falsely report baseline runs as applied_unverified. Needs maintainer input on where Snowpark should apply tuning-derived session settings before honest ledger capture can be added.
